# How to read the tree {.unnumbered}

Every definition and [theorem](proof-writing.qmd#def-theorem) on the Math Reference pages is one box, colored by kind.
A box sits below each definition and theorem it uses,
so the ones that use no others are at the top.
Hover over a box to see its name,
and click it to open its page.

::: {#dependency-graph-site}
:::
